column30: Sometimes LLMs assume something that doesn't exist or give different responses to the same prompt. This limits their use in critical applications. We are using an AI Agent platform to solve this issue and conducting research to improve reliability and consistency.
column31: Sometimes LLMs assume something that doesn't exist or give different responses to the same prompt. This limits their use in critical applications. We are using an AI Agent platform to solve this issue and conducting research to improve reliability and consistency.  We are addressing this problem with three distinct solutions.  GPTConsole: GPTConsole is a web platform for building AI agents. These agents work on tasks for long durations instead of just generating text. They have specific, reliable skills and are programmed to use these skills to complete goals given in natural language. They either finish the task completely or don't try at all if it's outside their capabilities, making them reliable. These agents don't use LLM to generate code; they use LLM to guide which skill to use to finish the task. They use advanced RAG architecture to retrieve and frame the right context for the LLM to make decisions. The LLM acts as a decision maker and guide for the agent to intelligently use skills to finish the task. This makes the agents hallucination-free and deterministic in nature.  API: Validates and tests LLM-generated code to ensure it is executable, Ensures the code performs exactly as the prompt asked, Provides a reliable and consistent interface for AI task execution  Research: Developing our own LLM focused on generating only executable code

column30: Precision Kinetica revolutionizes drug discovery for therapeutics by driving AI through the integration of physics-based multi-scale simulations, providing a platform ready for precise and efficient disease modeling across various therapeutic targets.
column31: Precision Kinetica aims to identify potent therapeutic targets to effectively combat diseases, advancing the discovery of novel treatments with greater precision and impact. The drug discovery process is troubled by inefficiencies and limitations, primarily due to a heavy reliance on thermodynamic calculations - such as molecular docking and binding free energy, and data-driven AI models that often need more physical insights. These approaches can sometimes be opaque; for example, machine-learned force fields for molecular simulations for drug discovery lead to errors and non-judicious use of resources, prolonged development times, and escalating costs. The focus on thermodynamics overlooks the critical role of kinetics - such as the rates of binding and unbinding and the drug-target un(binding) pathways involved, which are essential for a comprehensive understanding of drug-target interactions. This gap in the drug discovery process leads to suboptimal predictions, making it challenging to develop effective and reliable therapeutics efficiently.  Precision Kinetica tackles the inefficiencies in drug discovery with a multi-scale computational platform that uniquely integrates AI with physics-based simulations, spanning quantum mechanics, molecular dynamics, and Brownian dynamics. Unlike traditional data-driven models, our approach employs physics-informed parameters to drive AI integration within the pipeline. This enables precise predictions of kinetic and thermodynamic parameters within a single streamlined pipeline for highly accurate and interpretable insights, significantly simplifying and accelerating drug discovery. Our platform is transferable and adaptable, requiring simple modifications to apply to various therapeutic targets, reducing development timelines and costs.
